title: Publish the current Smart Salon site

requirements.text: Deploy (publish) the current Smart Salon application to the Internet Computer using the existing deployment process, and provide the live canister URL(s) for preview.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful deploy is performed for the current codebase (frontend and backend canisters as applicable).
The resulting live canister URL(s) are provided (at minimum, the frontend canister URL suitable for sharing and previewing in a browser).
The deployed site loads successfully at the provided URL and renders the Smart Salon landing page without runtime errors.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if state upgrades are required.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
nonGoals: Do not add new landing-page sections or new product features as part of publishing.
Do not introduce third-party hosting or external database/services for deployment.
